clips.title: The story
paras: After Khan Dez'hepah, Felgur Twocuts says the scared centaur clans must now be bled. Hunt centaur of any clan across Desolace and bring Felgur fifteen of their ears.

Felgur Twocuts says that now the centaur clans have been scared, it is time to bleed them. Whenever you travel Desolace, hunt centaur. Felgur does not care which clan you hunt, only that you gather ears, fifteen of them. Thinning their numbers will weaken their resolve and put an end to any thoughts of expansion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you scared the centaur clans, it's time to bleed them. When traveling Desolace, hunt centaur. I don't care which clan you hunt. Just gather ears. A hoard of ears.
By weakening their numbers you will weaken their resolve, and stamp out any thoughts of expansion.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How is your collection of ears, friend? Large?

clips.title: Completion
paras: By now, the centaur must know your name. I'm sure they know it, and respect it, and fear it. And just as they know you, they know the banner under which you ride.
